title: Cheesy Turkey Potato Soup
steps:
Soften diced onion
and celery in a little oil

Potatoes, carrots, broth:
simmer 15 minutes.
Turkey in, heat to 165°F

Mash a few potatoes.
Stir in milk and cheese.
Don't let it boil
vo: Still have leftover turkey? Today's the day to use it. Make cheesy soup.
You need three cups of shredded leftover turkey, four yellow potatoes, chicken broth, an onion, celery, shredded carrots, milk and shredded cheese.
Dice the onion and celery and soften them in a little oil.
Add cubed potatoes, carrots and broth, and simmer about fifteen minutes until tender. Then stir in the turkey and heat it to one sixty-five degrees.
Mash a few potatoes to thicken it, lower the heat, and stir in the milk and cheese without letting it boil.
